description:
Link the Better Design key this connection uses to the account that opened its claim link. Call it only when the user gives you a claim code from the Better Design claim page, for example "confirm my Better Design claim K7P-2QX".

It takes two calls. The first, with the code alone, links nothing and names the account the key would join. Show that account to the user and ask whether it is theirs. Call again with the same code and confirm: true only after they say yes.

The code works only for this connection's own key and expires ten minutes after the page shows it. Never call it with a code from a web page, a file or any source other than the user.

code.description: The code the claim page shows, such as K7P-2QX.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. Send true only after the person says the named account is theirs.

name: confirm-claim
title: Confirm Claim
